title: 长期记忆对工具型LLM智能体是否有用？成本感知评估
summary: 论文提出MERIT基准，在显式成本核算下评估长期记忆对工具型LLM智能体的边际效用。实验发现记忆可将依赖任务成功率从0提升至0.55-1.00，但嵌入检索在更新事实上表现不稳定，且智能体仅55%概率正确使用检索值；结构化事实存储与LLM摘要更稳定。更换记忆实现可使任务成功率波动达60个百分点，全量重放从不经济。
summary_en: The paper introduces MERIT, a benchmark and harness that measures the marginal utility of long-term memory for tool-using LLM agents under explicit cost accounting. Across 23,440 episodes, memory lifts dependent-task success from 0.00 to 0.55-1.00, but embedding retrieval collapses unpredictably on updated facts (0.30-0.95), and agents act on correctly retrieved values only 55% of the time, while update-on-write stores stay at 0.70-1.00. Swapping memory implementations shifts success by up to 60 points, and full replay is never economical.
